club.add_blocked: A camera sent this code, but that camera is linked to another account. Its owner can unlink it on their club page; if the camera is yours, ask OpenIPC's maintainers in the chat to unlink it.
club.add_limit: Up to {max} cameras count towards stars
club.add_privacy: Point it at something worth seeing: a view, the sky, a street from high up. Not at people, homes or number plates. Everyone can see the wall.
club.add_step1: Open your camera's web interface, then Extensions → OpenWall.
club.add_step2: Turn on Enable OpenWall and paste the code at the end of Caption.
club.add_step3: Save. The camera is linked with its next picture, within 15 minutes, and the code disappears from what the wall shows.
club.add_valid: Works until {time}, for one camera. Nobody else sees it: it is cut out of the caption before anything is stored or shown.
club.bot_on: The OpenIPC bot tells you when something you sent is reviewed.
club.cam_counting_age_help: It earns +{join} ★ once it has been linked for 30 days: {age} more to go.
club.cam_counting_help: It earns +{join} ★ after {days} more days with real pictures.
club.cam_dark_help: Its last pictures were black or blank. Check the lens and the night mode: it counts again from the next day with a real picture.
club.cam_limit_help: Only your first {max} linked cameras earn stars. Unlink one to let this one count.
club.cam_revoked_help: This camera was found not to be a real one, and earns nothing.
club.cam_show_owner: Show my name on its wall page
club.cam_silent_help: No picture has arrived from it for {n} days. Check its power, its network and its OpenWall settings.
club.cam_unlink_confirm: Unlink it? Its stars stay yours
club.cameras_empty: No camera linked yet. Link one below: it earns stars for every month it keeps sending real pictures to the Open Wall.
club.cameras_title: My cameras on the Open Wall
club.code_add_ipctool: Add ipctool's report from this camera
club.code_get: Send ipctool's report from a camera
club.code_joins: Run this on the same camera within a day. Its report becomes yours and goes with this one, under the same board.
club.code_own: Run this on the camera within a day. The report becomes yours and earns stars once a maintainer accepts it.
club.code_stock_link: How to get it onto the camera
club.confirm_text: This link was asked for in another browser. Sign in only if {who} is yours: whatever you send while signed in goes to that account.
club.duplicate: The catalogue already has this dump
club.email_label: We'll email you a link that signs you in. No password.
club.email_sent: Check {email}: the link signs you in once, within ten minutes.
club.lb_empty: Nobody on the leaderboard has stars yet. A linked camera earns its first 5 stars no sooner than 30 days after it was linked, once it has had at least 20 days of lit, changing pictures since; a report earns stars when a maintainer publishes it.
club.lb_empty_30d: Nobody on the leaderboard earned stars in the last 30 days.
club.lb_note: Every member with stars appears here unless they opted out on their club page. Ranked by stars, never by how many cameras someone has.
club.load_failed: The club could not be reached. Try again in a minute.
club.mine_empty: Nothing sent yet. Open your board in the catalogue and send what it prints.
club.new_board_hint: What is printed on the board, or the model on the box
club.new_dump_hint: Optional. Read the chip with a programmer when ipctool cannot run on the camera, for example behind a U-Boot password; a dump nobody sent before earns {n} ★.
club.new_lede: Name the maker and the board, and add photos of it: the board's front and back, and the label. A maintainer adds it to the catalogue when they publish your report; each photo and file earns {n} ★, and a whole-flash dump nobody sent before {dump} ★.
club.new_link: Add a camera that is not in the catalogue
club.new_more: Have ipctool's output or a boot log? Add them too
club.new_need: Name the maker and the board, and add at least one photo.
club.rename_label: Your name, as it appears on the boards your reports reach
club.review_done_board: Published, and {board} added to the catalogue. {points} ★ to the sender.
club.review_existing: The catalogue already has {board}: the report is published there unless you change the board ids below.
club.review_forbidden: Only OpenIPC's maintainers review. Sign in with GitHub as a member of the OpenIPC organisation.
club.review_maker_known: its maker is in the catalogue
club.review_models: Board ids to publish it on, comma-separated (empty: the board the sender named)
club.review_new_board: Add this board to the catalogue when publishing
club.rules_dump: Full flash dump the catalogue doesn't have
club.rules_item: Boot log, U-Boot console, photo, pinout, ipctool report
club.rules_join: A camera you linked has sent pictures for 30 days since, real ones on 20 separate days
club.rules_month: Every further 30 days that camera keeps sending real pictures
club.rules_none: A dump the catalogue already holds, or anything not accepted
club.rules_note: Reports earn stars when a maintainer accepts them, never on upload. Cameras earn theirs once a night, from the days they kept sending pictures; stars for a camera found to be fake are taken back.
club.rules_rare: The first camera on the wall with its chip or its sensor
club.send_dump: The whole chip, as a programmer read it or as an ipctool backup
club.send_empty: Add a file, a photo or some text first.
club.send_guest: You can send without signing in. Sign in to collect stars and follow what happens to it.
club.send_note: Anything else: where you bought it, what it is sold as
club.send_paste: Paste the text here, or choose a file below
club.send_photos: Photos: the front, the back, the UART pins
club.send_public: Publish the dump with the report. It holds Wi-Fi keys and passwords: leave this off to keep it private.
club.send_signed_in: Signed in as {name}. Stars count once a maintainer accepts it.
club.sent_guest: Received as {id}. A maintainer reviews it before it is shown.
club.sent_member: Received as {id}. A maintainer reviews it before it is shown; follow it in My submissions.
club.signin_elsewhere: That sign-in belongs to the browser that started it. Start again here.
club.signin_expired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Start again below.
club.signin_failed: The sign-in did not complete. Try again, or use another way in.
club.tg_hint: No password: tap Start in the OpenIPC bot
club.tg_step1: Scan the code with your phone's camera, or open Telegram on this computer.
club.tg_step2: Tap Start in the chat with {bot}, then Yes.
club.tg_step3: Come back here. This page signs you in by itself.
club.tg_waiting: Waiting for Telegram… This code works for {time} more.
club.unavailable: Not available on this site yet.
club.why_1: See whether what you sent was accepted, and where it appears.
club.why_2: Keep your flash dumps private: only you and OpenIPC's maintainers can download them.
club.why_3: Collect stars for what you document and for keeping a camera on the Open Wall, and your name next to the boards you documented.
club.why_note: You don't need an account to browse or download firmware. The site sets no cookie for anyone who doesn't sign in.

boards.mfw_lead: Each build is made for one device type: the module, its hardware revision (V0, V5) and its flavour (4G, TF card, AF zoom, a lens block). Flash only the build made for your board. Newest first.
boards.mfw_notes: for camera modules it publishes the bare module's firmware only; a finished camera's maker may ship a customised build (AF zoom, PTZ, GB28181) that a module build can remove. Upgrading long-used older modules carries a risk of bricking them.
